correctness.rationale: Nash-Williams was reduced to induced-set density inequalities, including one-sided subsets and the cycle-rank-eight obstruction.

originality.rationale: The assessment found only general join bounds and examples in the motivating preprint.

value.rationale: The stated value was an exact join-arboricity criterion and a sharp universal cycle-rank-seven threshold.

historical_nonindependent_review.disclaimer: Historical non-independent assessment; not independent validation.
